import sys


def main():
    s = sys.stdin.read().split()[0]
    n = len(s)
    ans = 0
    p = n  # s[p:] has already become all tail
    tail = ''
    r = n - 1
    while r >= 0:
        l = r
        while l > 0 and s[l - 1] == s[r]:
            l -= 1
        if r - l + 1 >= 2:
            # this run spreads right over every character that differs from it
            y = s[r]
            ans += (p - (r + 1)) - s.count(y, r + 1, p)
            if p < n and tail != y:
                ans += n - p
            p, tail = l, y
        r = l - 1
    print(ans)


main()
